newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance unaffected by tax reliefs.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance unaffected by tax reliefs.

text.p: India's largest private firm Reliance Industries Ltd does not stand to benefit from exemptions from minimum alternate tax (MAT) announced by the federal government on Wednesday, industry sources said.
"Neither Patalganga nor Hazira come under backward area classification," officials of other firms with units in these two districts in western India said.
Reliance has two major petrochemical complexes, one located at Patalganga in the western state of Maharashtra, and the second newer, facility in Hazira on the Gujarat coast.
Finance Minister P.Chidambaram told parliament that industries located in areas notified as "backward" would be exempt from MAT.
MAT was introduced in the Indian federal budget for 1996/97 presented to parliament on July 22.
Analysts had downgraded earnings expectations of some of India's leading firms, including Reliance, because of MAT's impact.
